about.title: About
about.intro: Hi, I'm Harry. This is my personal website.

hero.subtitle: PRODUCT DESIGN
hero.descriptionIntro: ISN'T ABOUT CRAFTING DAZZLING VISUALS OR BUILDING CUTTING-EDGE TECH.
hero.descriptionLine1: IT'S ABOUT APPLYING INSIGHT AND ANALYSIS TO REACH THE RIGHT USERS

whoAmI.title: Who AM I?
whoAmI.paragraph1: I'm Harry, with nearly 15 years' experience in Product Design and Front-end Development.
whoAmI.paragraph2: I work as a Product designer and Front-end engineer, and I'm also a Design Systems course instructor at AAPD — using Design System to build processes and component libraries that help design and engineering collaborate efficiently, shorten time-to-market, and accelerate validation.
whoAmI.paragraph3: I also founded and have operated awwrated, a streaming information platform, for 6 years — growing the user base by 300% and page views by 800%.

awards.title: Awards
awards.description: I have participated in multiple Website and Product designs and have received the following international awards for recognition.

clients.title: Clients & Partners
clients.paragraph1:
Serving startups and enterprises alike:
Product Design / Web Design /
Design System Training & Consulting.
clients.paragraph2: A Systems-driven approach that helps teams ship faster and improve consistency.

background.title: My design background
background.line1: My design inspiration didn't come from textbooks,
background.line2: but from the startup sound of the Famicom (NES).
background.line3:
Japanese culture of the 1980s, 8-bit pixels, tokusatsu, 
and anime taught me to tell stories with images.
background.line4: I once aimed to become a manga artist or game illustrator~
background.line5: Now I turn that obsession into a design methodology,
background.line6: building products that are more loved and more usable.

items.title: Ex-Shopmatic Chief Product Officer
items.name: Kris
items.testimonial:
I have over six years of experience collaborating with Harry, including his tenure at the e-commerce software company I founded. Harry played a core role in product UI design and was responsible for final product refinement.
Harry not only possesses exceptional professional aesthetic sensibilities and can precisely capture and define a product's visual style, but his most unique value lies in his ability to serve as a perfect bridge between design and front-end engineering.
He can accurately understand technical constraints and requirements from an engineering perspective and deliver designs based on this foundation. This greatly enhances collaborative efficiency in the development process, ensuring the quality and precision of the final results. Harry demonstrates remarkable efficiency and refined professionalism that is extremely rare in cross-departmental collaboration.
With his combination of a designer's artistic vision and an engineer's logical thinking, Harry brings aesthetically pleasing and highly practical product solutions to any project. I wholeheartedly recommend Harry's professional capabilities.

items.title: Ex-Shopmatic Head of User Experience & Design
items.name: Darwin Ng
items.testimonial: I had the pleasure of working closely with Harry for around 7 years at Shopmatic. Harry consistently impressed me not only with his exceptional design skills but also with his proficiency in front-end development, bridging the gap between design and implementation seamlessly. He approaches projects with creativity, attention to detail, and a collaborative mindset, making him a trusted partner on any team. I wholeheartedly recommend Harry for any design and development work.

items.title: Ex-Shopmatic Sr. Project Manager
items.name: Freddie Wynne
items.testimonial: I’ve had the pleasure of working with Harry both professionally and on private projects, and he consistently brings a fresh, unique design direction to everything he touches. His attention to detail is exceptional, and he has an intuitive understanding of the customer he’s designing for - something that elevates his work far beyond the expected. Harry combines creativity with a deep sense of purpose, making collaboration with him both inspiring and fun.

items.title: Ex-Shopmatic Sr. Engineer
items.name: Thenn Arasan
items.testimonial: From an engineering perspective, Harry is a dream to work with. His designs are always implementable and he provides clear documentation and specifications. He understands the technical challenges we face and works collaboratively to find solutions that work for both design and development. His knowledge of front-end technologies is extensive, and he's always willing to jump in and help with implementation. Harry's design system work has dramatically improved our code quality and development speed.

items.title: AAPD CEO & Canva Staff Designer
items.name: Simon Lin
items.testimonial: As an educator and design professional, I've had the privilege of collaborating with Harry on design systems training. His teaching methodology is clear, practical, and rooted in real-world experience. Harry has a gift for breaking down complex design system concepts into digestible lessons that students can immediately apply. His passion for design systems and his commitment to sharing knowledge with the community is commendable. He's not just a skilled practitioner but also an excellent mentor.

items.title: Payday Product Designer
items.name: Ryan
items.testimonial: Harry's design philosophy centers around solving real user problems rather than just creating beautiful interfaces. This user-first approach, combined with his technical prowess, results in products that are both delightful and functional. He has an impressive ability to analyze complex user journeys and simplify them into intuitive experiences. Harry's work on design systems has set a high standard for consistency and efficiency. His insights and feedback have consistently elevated our design quality.

items.title: Qnap Product Designer
items.name: Astrid
items.testimonial: Harry brings a level of professionalism and expertise that is hard to find. His attention to detail is impeccable, and his designs are always thoroughly researched and validated. He has a strong understanding of design principles and applies them consistently across all touchpoints. Working with Harry on design system implementation has taught me valuable lessons about scalability and maintainability. His collaborative spirit and willingness to share knowledge make him an excellent team member.

items.title: MacroMicro CTO
items.name: Ken Wang
items.testimonial: Harry's dual expertise in design and development is invaluable. He speaks both languages fluently, which makes cross-functional collaboration incredibly smooth. His technical understanding allows him to make design decisions that are not only user-friendly but also technically sound and efficient to implement. Harry's work on our design system has significantly reduced technical debt and improved our product consistency. His strategic thinking and execution capabilities are truly first-rate.

items.title: Ex-TutorMing General Manager
items.name: Andrew Tsai
items.testimonial: From a business perspective, Harry delivers exceptional value. He understands that design is not just about aesthetics but about driving business outcomes. His data-driven approach to design decisions and his ability to balance user needs with business goals is remarkable. Harry's leadership in establishing design systems has accelerated our product development cycles and improved consistency across our platforms. He's a strategic thinker who contributes far beyond just design execution.

items.title: KKDay Sr. Project Manager
items.name: Sherry Shih
items.testimonial: Harry is an outstanding product designer who consistently delivers exceptional results. His process is thorough, from research to final implementation, and he maintains high standards throughout. He's responsive to feedback and iterates quickly without compromising quality. Harry's ability to manage complex projects while maintaining attention to detail is impressive. His design system expertise has transformed how our teams work together, creating a more efficient and cohesive product development process. Highly recommended!

contact.title: CONTACT
contact.subtitle: Have a design or development need? If you're looking for a partner with 15 years in product design, development, and operations, drop me a line — or challenge me to an 8-bit game :D

projectInfo.description: Introducing the Shopmatic Design System: a framework to streamline design and enhance user experience. It offers components, guidelines, and best practices for creating appealing and functional digital products. Whether you're a designer or developer, it's your resource for intuitive interfaces.

scope.title: Scope
scope.paragraph1: The Shopmatic Design System optimizes design processes and enhances user experiences across digital platforms. It includes components, guidelines, and best practices for designers and developers. This cohesive set of tools empowers teams to create appealing and functional digital products.
scope.paragraph2: Designed for collaboration and consistency, it features reusable components for uniformity across applications. Guidelines cover typography, color schemes, and layout principles, aiding informed design choices.
scope.paragraph3: The system emphasizes user-centered design, prioritizing user needs to craft intuitive interfaces for seamless interactions. Whether starting a new project or refining one, it is essential for design excellence.

impact.title: Impact
impact.paragraph1: The Shopmatic Design System has a significant impact on digital design by streamlining processes and enhancing user experiences. It offers a robust framework filled with reusable components and design guidelines that promote consistency across projects. By focusing on user-centered design, it ensures that interfaces are intuitive and engaging. This system not only assists designers and developers in creating visually appealing products but also fosters collaboration, making it an essential resource for achieving design excellence.
impact.quote1: "Rating Credibility" Rule: Weighted by the number of raters to reduce early sample bias.
impact.quote2: Sorting and Filtering Rules: Multi-dimensional based on popularity, recency, highest scores, and number of ratings.
impact.quote3: GA event tracking + Hotjar heatmaps, introduced for data-driven design iterations.
impact.blockquote: The Shopmatic Design System ensures a cohesive, user-friendly experience. It provides guidelines for design consistency, enhancing brand identity and user engagement.

get in touch.title: GET IN TOUCH
get in touch.paragraph1: If you're interested in the Shopmatic Design System for your project, feel free to reach out! I'm here to help you navigate through the design process and ensure you get the most out of this powerful framework. Whether you need assistance with user-centered design or want to enhance your project's visual appeal, I'm just an email away.
get in touch.paragraph2: Don't hesitate to contact me at harrychuang23@gmail.com.
get in touch.paragraph3: Let's collaborate to create something exceptional!
